EIHL Schedule

Source: R/esports.R
eihl_schedule.Rd

Schedule and results of one competition season, one row per match, played or not.

Wraps GET https://s3.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/eihl.hokejovyzapis.cz/league-matches/{season}/{league_id}.json of the EIHL eSports bucket. Example: https://s3.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/eihl.hokejovyzapis.cz/league-matches/2026/3.json. Seasons are END years (2027 = 2026/27); every request waits at least one second after the last one to the same host.

Usage

eihl_schedule(season, league_id = 3L, return_parsed = TRUE)

Arguments

season

Season by its END year (2027 = 2026/27). The bucket keys seasons by their START year; the wrapper requests season - 1.

league_id

Competition id. 3 = Elite League, 4 = Challenge Cup, 5 = playoffs.

return_parsed

Parse the payload into a tibble (default TRUE); FALSE returns the raw decoded JSON body (a nested list).

Value

A tibble::tibble() with one row per row of the file (zero rows, carrying the documented columns, for an empty frame); the raw JSON list when return_parsed = FALSE. Columns:

col_nametypedescription
match_idintegerMatch id (per-bucket match key space); joins to the {match_id} path param of the game wrappers.
start_datecharacterScheduled face-off, local YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS; DEL playoff placeholders read 0000-00-00 ....
league_idintegerLeague id (per-bucket competition key space); joins to the {league_id} path param.
leaguecharacterLeague display name, e.g. DEL, EIHL, Metal Ligaen.
seasonintegerSeason by its END year (2027 = 2026/27); the body's START-year key plus one.
roundcharacterRound number as a string ("1", "249"); DEL values carry a leading U+FEFF byte-order mark, empty string in Denmark.
groupcharacterGroup name in group stages; empty string or null otherwise.
home_idintegerTeam id (team key space, per bucket, stable across seasons); joins to league-matches home.id / guest.id and the {team_id} path param.
home_namecharacterTeam display name.
home_shortcutcharacterThree-letter team code.
guest_idintegerTeam id (team key space, per bucket, stable across seasons); joins to league-matches home.id / guest.id and the {team_id} path param.
guest_namecharacterTeam display name.
guest_shortcutcharacterThree-letter team code.
statuscharacterMatch status: BEFORE_MATCH, LIVE, AFTER_MATCH.
overtime_countintegerNumber of overtime periods played; null in the samples.
extra_timelogicalTrue when the game went to overtime.
shootinglogicalTrue when the game was decided by a shootout.
contumacylogicalTrue when the result was awarded by forfeit.
final_score_homeintegerHome team goals in that span.
final_score_guestintegerVisiting team goals in that span.
first_period_score_homeintegerHome team goals in that span.
first_period_score_guestintegerVisiting team goals in that span.
second_period_score_homeintegerHome team goals in that span.
second_period_score_guestintegerVisiting team goals in that span.
third_period_score_homeintegerHome team goals in that span.
third_period_score_guestintegerVisiting team goals in that span.
actual_time_namecharacterDisplay label of the game state in the bucket's language, e.g. end, Ende, before game.
actual_time_aliascharacterShort game-state code: K = finished (Czech konec), 0 = not started.
last_event_timeintegerGame second of the latest event, of game time from the opening face-off (0-3600 in regulation, continuing through overtime).
arenacharacterArena name; empty string or null where not set.

Errors

Signalled as classed conditions: fastRhockey_no_data when the bucket has no such key (S3 404 NoSuchKey: unknown season, competition, match or team) or the file holds no rows (an unplayed game, an empty shot shell); fastRhockey_asset_fetch for any other non-2xx answer (403 AccessDenied), a connection failure after retries, an empty or unreadable 200 body, an error envelope, a body of the wrong shape, or a body for another season or game; fastRhockey_bad_request for an HTTP 400/422 or an invalid argument. All three also inherit fastRhockey_error. Wrappers raise; they never warn and return an empty frame.

See also

EIHL (the league site whose widgets read this public eSports bucket)

Other EIHL eSports functions: eihl_game_info(), eihl_goalie_box(), eihl_pbp(), eihl_player_box(), eihl_shots(), eihl_standings(), eihl_team_player_stats(), eihl_top_scorers()
